cases.claim: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (HSCT-T) dosage may not be diagnostic if the onset of symptoms occurs less than 3 hours before acute myocardial injury (AMI).
cases.operator_reason: Timing in the claim is relative to injury, not presentation; the abstract limits triage after symptom onset, not timing before injury.

cases.claim: Sildenafil improves erectile function in men who experience sexual dysfunction as a result of the use of SSRI antidepressants.
cases.operator_reason: Explicit improved erectile function in men with SRI-associated dysfunction.

cases.claim: Enhanced early production of inflammatory chemokines improves viral control in the lung.
cases.operator_reason: Memory T cell enhancement of cytokines and chemokines led to early influenza control.

cases.claim: TCR/CD3 microdomains are a required to induce the immunologic synapse to activate T cells.
cases.operator_reason: Multivalent engagement and CD3 conformational change required; immunologic synapse or TCR microdomains not established.

cases.claim: Varenicline monotherapy is more effective after 12 weeks of treatment compared to combination nicotine replacement therapies with varenicline or bupropion.
cases.operator_reason: Trial compares varenicline plus bupropion, not nicotine replacement therapies; distinction between prolonged abstinence and point prevalence.

cases.claim: PD-1 triggering on monocytes reduces IL-10 production by monocytes.
cases.operator_reason: PD-1 triggering induces rather than reduces IL-10 production.

cases.claim: Ly6C hi monocytes have a lower inflammatory capacity than Ly6C lo monocytes.
cases.operator_reason: Recruitment and immature monocyte frequency are measured, not a general inflammatory capacity comparison.

cases.claim: Increased vessel density along with a reduction in fibrosis decreases the efficacy of chemotherapy treatments.
cases.operator_reason: In the reported mouse model stromal depletion and higher vascular density improved delivery and produced transient stabilization, opposite the asserted direction; not universal.
